decision.summary: No new action: the weekly 76k dip is working well, the daily 76k dip remains alive, and there is no justified additional trade with only four hours left in the daily market.
decision.rationale: Reconciliation is clean. BTC spot is around 76872 and Binance remains bearish short-term, with price near the session low and no meaningful upside reversal. The weekly 76k dip is performing well at roughly 81.5%, but it is still below the 90-95% take-profit zone, so there is no management action yet. The daily 76k dip has weakened to around 28%, but it remains above the 20% discarded-for-slot threshold and therefore still occupies the daily thesis slot. There is no cleaner additional setup to add: lower daily dip strikes are too weak for a fresh late-session entry, upside reach markets are even weaker, and the current bearish positions already express the thesis cleanly. With only four hours left in the daily market, the disciplined decision is NO_ACTION.
